verdict.rationale: Lambda has a public pricing page that promises "clear, straightforward pricing" for self-serve B200, H100, A100 and GH200 instances, and ODC is documented as priced by hourly usage. A community report also cites a published H100 rate of $1.99/GPU/hour. However, no evidence shows actual per-GPU-hour figures listed for every GPU type, and reserved capacity pricing requires contacting sales. Missing for 10: verbatim per-GPU-hour prices for each GPU type on the pricing page, pricing for reserved/cluster tiers without contacting sales, independent corroboration of current published rates.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can see the published per-GPU-hour price for every GPU type on a public pricing page without talking to sales

citations.quote: Clear, straightforward pricing for Instances, 1-Click Clusters™, and Superclusters.
Deploy NVIDIA B200, H100, A100, or GH200 instances in minutes with self-serve, first-come access.
ODC prices instances by hourly usage and bills in one-minute increments.
Lambda Labs dropped H100 on-demand GPU pricing to $1.99/GPU/Hour
